integrity: This is a mathematically argued best-knowledge result, not a uniqueness certificate for the literature; potential equivalent work under different matrix-function language remains possible.
scientific_limitations: Only symmetric balanced bipartite weighted complete-minus-matching graphs with two cross-edge conductances, n>=3, and completed two-stage Gauss-Legendre diffusion steps; no asymmetric graphs or Runge-Kutta stagewise positivity. The all-parameter result is analytical and finite checks are illustrative, not proof.
title: Two-sided matching-weight interval for unconditional fourth-order diffusion positivity
